description: BF16 ring producer implemented locally in isolated directory. Awaiting Codex review of approach.

changes: 1. Added member variables: recent128LatentRingGm_ (bfloat16_t*), recent128RingSlotsGm_ (int32_t*), recent128RingCapacity_ (int64_t*), recent128RingEnabled_ (bool)
2. Added SetRecent128Ring(latentRing, ringSlots, ringCapacity) method - sets GM pointers and enables ring

3. Added ring write code in RmsNormAndQuantizeCkv between RmsNormNormal and QuantPerTileMxFp4: reads ringSlot from recent128RingSlotsGm_(tokenIndex), if slot>=0: Cast FP32->BF16 to sharedBuf scratch, DataCopy 512 BF16 to recent128LatentRingGm_[ringSlot%capacity * 512]
4. Cast API used: Cast(bf16Local, inputLocal, RoundMode::CAST_RINT, kvElemCount, 1, {1, 1, 8, 4})
5. Ring capacity read from device: recent128RingCapacity_.GetValue(0) then ringSlot % capacity
kernel_class_modification.write_point: Between RmsNormNormal() + DataSyncBarrier and QuantPerTileMxFp4() in RmsNormAndQuantizeCkv
kernel_class_modification.data_flow: RmsNormNormal outputs FP32 to inputLocal (UB) -> [RING WRITE: Cast to BF16, DataCopy to ring GM] -> QuantPerTileMxFp4 consumes inputLocal (unchanged) -> ScatterCkv

changes: 2. Added 3 params before workspace: __gm__ uint8_t *recent128LatentRing, __gm__ uint8_t *recent128RingSlots, __gm__ uint8_t *recent128RingCapacity

3. Before all 21 op.Process() calls: op.SetRecent128Ring(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(recent128LatentRing), reinterpret_cast<__gm__ int32_t*>(recent128RingSlots), reinterpret_cast<__gm__ int64_t*>(recent128RingCapacity))

other_kernel_classes.changes: Added no-op SetRecent128Ring to CloudMlaPrologV3SplitM and arch22 CloudMlaPrologVecS1CubS2 for compilation compatibility

new_files_created.op_proto: cloud_mla_prolog_v3_recent128_proto.h - V3 proto + 3 optional ring inputs + recent_window attr
new_files_created.tbe_script: dynamic_cloud_mla_prolog_v3_recent128.py - V3 TBE + ring inputs + BUILD_KERNEL_SRC override
new_files_created.python_wrapper: cloud_mla_prolog_v3_recent128_wrapper.py - recent128_abi_version=1, OFF passthrough to V3, ON calls new operator

implementation_notes.abi_compliance: Wrapper has recent128_abi_version = 1 as required by prolog_provider.py
implementation_notes.off_mode: When recent_latent is None, wrapper falls through to original cloud_ops_turbo_lib.cloud_mla_prolog (exact V3 behavior)
implementation_notes.on_mode: When ring provided, kernel additionally writes BF16 pre-quant KV to ring. Original C4 quantization unchanged.
implementation_notes.first_version_limitations: Single pool (P=1) only. Ring slot computed as ringSlot % capacity. Rope ring and position/epoch tags not yet written (only latent ring). max_query_per_request not used in kernel yet.

compilation_status.tbe_script_install: PENDING - dynamic/ directory write permission issue
